crossRefs.note: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with…
“You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of…
“You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of…
They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.
“They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.
“You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make…
On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold…
“You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.
